description.zh: 让所有功能都能只用键盘完成：Tab/Shift+Tab 按合理顺序移动焦点，复合组件内用方向键漫游并配 roving tabindex，Escape 关闭浮层并归还焦点。这是焦点环之外的一整套焦点秩序，规则写在 ARIA APG 里。
description.en: Make every feature operable by keyboard alone: Tab/Shift+Tab move focus in a sane order, composite widgets roam with arrow keys over a roving tabindex, Escape dismisses overlays and returns focus. The full focus discipline beyond the focus ring, codified in the ARIA APG.

use_when.zh: 工具栏、菜单、标签页等复合组件的组内焦点管理
use_when.en: Focus management inside composites — toolbars, menus, tab lists

use_when.zh: 弹层、抽屉、对话框需要打开与关闭的焦点闭环
use_when.en: Overlays that need an open/close focus loop

use_when.zh: 任何必须「无鼠标可完成」的核心流程
use_when.en: Any core flow that must be completable without a mouse

avoid_when.zh: 用 tabindex="0" 把非交互元素强行拉进 Tab 序
avoid_when.en: Dragging non-interactive nodes into the tab order with tabindex="0"

avoid_when.zh: 组内每个项都 tabindex="0"，方向键又不能漫游
avoid_when.en: Making every item tabbable while arrows do not roam

avoid_when.zh: Escape 关掉浮层后焦点掉回 body 顶
avoid_when.en: Escape closing an overlay and dropping focus at the top of body

disambiguation.zh: 「Tab 键」是移动焦点的按键，「标签页（Tabs）」是一个组件——英文同形，中文口语都可能说成 Tab，一个是输入按键，一个是界面元素。
disambiguation.en: The Tab key moves focus; Tabs is a component. Same English word, two completely different things — one is an input key, one is a UI element.

note.zh: tabs 是标签页组件；keyboard-navigation 里的 Tab 键是焦点移动按键——同名不同物。
note.en: tabs is the tab component; the Tab key in keyboard-navigation is the focus-mover — same word, different things.

note.zh: DOM 顺序即焦点顺序，页面级默认
note.en: DOM order is focus order — the page-level default

note.zh: 组内仅一项 tabindex="0"，方向键切换
note.en: One tabindex="0" inside the group, arrows move it

note.zh: 关闭浮层后焦点回到触发元素
note.en: Closing an overlay returns focus to its trigger

notes.zh: 页面级用自然 DOM 顺序 + 原生可交互元素，别用正数 tabindex 重排。复合组件按 APG：组内一项 tabindex="0" 其余 -1，keydown 处理方向键/Home/End 并 .focus() 目标项；浮层打开时焦点移入，Escape 关闭并归还触发元素。keydown 里 preventDefault 前先确认按键属于该组件。
notes.en: Page level: natural DOM order with native interactive elements — never positive tabindex. Composites per APG: one tabindex="0" in the group, -1 elsewhere; keydown handles arrows/Home/End and focuses the target item. On open, move focus into the overlay; Escape closes and restores the trigger. Only preventDefault a key once you know the widget owns it.

basic.zh: 让页面和组件完整支持键盘操作：Tab 移动、方向键选择、Escape 关闭。
basic.en: Make the page and components fully keyboard operable — Tab to move, arrows to pick, Escape to dismiss.

design.zh: 焦点顺序与视觉顺序一致；工具栏与菜单组内只占一个 Tab 站点、方向键漫游；弹层打开焦点移入、Escape 关闭并回到触发按钮；每个焦点位置都有可见焦点环。
design.en: Focus order matches visual order; toolbars and menus occupy one tab stop and roam with arrows; overlays take focus on open and return it to the trigger on Escape; every stop shows a visible focus ring.

implementation.zh: 组合式组件：container role + 项目 refs，state 记录 activeIndex；tabIndex={i === active ? 0 : -1}；onKeyDown 分发 Arrow/Home/End 后 focus(next)。浮层用 dialog/role="menu"，打开 focus 首项、Escape 关闭并 trigger.focus()。
implementation.en: Composite: container role plus item refs, state tracks activeIndex; `tabIndex={i === active ? 0 : -1}`; onKeyDown maps Arrow/Home/End then focus(next). Overlays use dialog or role="menu", focus the first item on open, Escape closes and calls trigger.focus().

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现完整键盘导航。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- Tab 顺序与视觉顺序一致，不使用正数 tabindex
- 复合组件方向键漫游 + roving tabindex
- 浮层 Escape 关闭并把焦点还给触发元素
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement complete keyboard navigation in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse current components.
Requirements:
- Focus order matches visual order; no positive tabindex
- Composites roam with arrow keys over a roving tabindex
- Escape closes overlays and returns focus to the trigger
Keep the existing visual style. Add no unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run the project's existing checks when done and list the modified files.
